exemplar subject

  • CURIE: gmeow:exemplarSubject
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exemplarSubject
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms

The entity whose pattern the exemplar evidences — a frame-scoped character whose conduct across the cited work is the example (EPIC: 823 such links in the foundation corpus), an organization, a person. Range intentionally open. NOT functional, optional: span-pinned exemplars need no subject, and subject + selector may coexist (the span shows one instance of the pattern; the subject names its bearer). At least one of viaSelector / exemplarSubject (SHACL).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Exemplar -> ?

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:exemplarSubject from gmeow:Exemplar to ? when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
